card.name: Words introducing a purpose or hope
card.fires_on: Small linking or abstract words right before a stated aim, hope or expectation, such as "to" after "not work just", "in the hope" or "purpose of". Also some words after try, think or confident that lead into a clause about what someone intends or believes.

modes.label: Purpose or hope phrases
modes.description: Words like hope, hopes, expectation, purpose of that lead into a goal.
modes.example: in the<< hopes>> of bettering their miserable situation

modes.label: Infinitive after a goal-setting verb
modes.description: The word "to" or an adverb after verbs of aiming or trying, before the aim is stated.
modes.example: They did not work just<< to>> generate an income.

modes.label: Contrast or belief setups
modes.description: Words like But or thought that open a clause about what someone holds or fears.
modes.example: She <<thought>> she would never get over feeling so stupid
